description: Boundary coordinates of Itu irrigation and flood control area in Akwa Ibom State Nigeria is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. Processed raw data from Global Positioning System (GPS) observation. Coordinates of points obtained within regular intervals to determine the plan of the irrigation design. These coordinates include the Northings, Eastings and Heights. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Geoinformatics, Surveying. The repository dates the deposit 2018; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
